title: Lazar's work on power and propulsion in Project Galileo

tellings.quote: to know, like how Bob was on power and propulsion, you know, with Project Galileo.

plain: Between 1987 and 1989 in Nevada, Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret desert site, is said to have worked on the power and propulsion side of Project Galileo, a secret effort he describes as studying how those craft fly. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who has long championed Lazar, tells Michels this second-hand, from what Lazar has told him.
